title: Crispy Fried Squid
description: A simple, flavorful Chinese-inspired dish that combines the delicate taste of squid with a crispy exterior.
instructions: Heat 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a wok or deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Cut the squid into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
In a shallow dish, mix together the crushed cookies and chinese salt.
Dredge the squid pieces in the cookie mixture, shaking off excess.
Carefully add the coated squid to the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the fried squid from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
